name: Just a baseplate
desc:
🕹️Welcome to a clean and open baseplate made for testing, experimenting, or just messing around with your friends. Enjoy boombox fun, private servers, and voice chat.
👍Don't forget to like the game and favorite for more updates!
🏆Join our group for a rainbow name!! https://www.roblox.com/es/communities/852454504/GoofyDevStudios#!/about
Commands available:
-re (quick respawn)
-rj (instant rejoin)
-fps (toggle fps)
-sit (sit animation)
